title: AReaL Host current local and Remote protocol
description: Host local Unix, authenticated loopback WebSocket and Remote wire variants. Scalar constraints, authorization and mutable ownership remain runtime responsibilities. Examples are schema fixtures, not execution receipts.

OpaquePayload.description: Core-owned tool arguments and plugin-defined payload leaves are passed through as JSON.

VaultValue.description: Vault slot values are owner-specific credential strings, account or transport records, or explicit revocation null; not a protocol envelope.

IgnoredValue.description: This field is accepted but never examined by this current branch; arbitrary JSON preserves that acceptance.

RemoteConfig.description: The persistence owner validates identity and project scopes only. Other stored configuration fields remain uninterpreted; Gateway consumers validate them when used.

text.description: Released clients must send non-whitespace text; gui-write-v1 clients may send empty text when other input is present.

attachments.description: gui-write-v1 only. Blob references from attachment upload.

items.description: May also carry _meta, which Host forwards as an MCP resource_link block.

conversationQuotes.description: gui-write-v1 only. At most 16000 UTF-16 units in total.

mcpContent.description: gui-write-v1 only. MCP content blocks, each at most 64 KiB, 512 KiB in total.

writeLimits.description: Present only after gui-write-v1 negotiation. Input limits match the desktop composer; released clients keep limits.commandTextBytes and text-only sends.

LegacyProviderConfiguration.description: The legacy providers document is retained as source-owned configuration data, including provider extensions.

LegacyLoginTarget.description: Legacy login target is accepted as JSON. The owner interprets newAccount/saved kinds and treats every other shape as the current account; mutable login state may bypass target processing.

writeMethods.description: Present only for a desktop-ticket connection that negotiated gui-write-v1. Requests use the Remote envelope fields context (projectId, serviceGeneration, gatewayGeneration, grantRevision 0) and commandId.

writeLimits.description: Present only after gui-write-v1 negotiation. Input limits match the desktop composer; released clients keep limits.commandTextBytes and text-only sends.

NativeCoreObject.description: Unmodified native Core payload; Core owns its nested schema and history cursors. Host validates subscription identity and per-page byte limits.
NativeCoreObject.x-source: core/protocol/src/desktop.rs and core/app-server conversation observation/history serializers; fields validated by their Core owner and existing GUI read decoders

RemoteShellSubscribeRequest.description: Available only after gui-read-v1 hello negotiation; project and navigation content remain constrained by the existing device grant.

RemoteShellUnsubscribeRequest.description: Available only after gui-read-v1 hello negotiation; project and navigation content remain constrained by the existing device grant.

framing.authentication: single-use ticket in first hello; exact Origin and Host; no query
